cards.ex: My niece is sharp as a tack; she learns everything so quickly.
cards.exUz: Jiyanim juda o'tkir zehnli; u hamma narsani juda tez o'rganadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda aqlli, tez fahmlaydigan odamni tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: He's a nice guy, but honestly, he's not the sharpest tool in the shed.
cards.exUz: U yaxshi yigit, lekin rostini aytsam, u uncha aqlli emas.
cards.uzDef: Aqli zaifroq yoki uncha aqlli bo'lmagan odam haqida aytiladi.

cards.ex: I had a total brain fart and forgot her name.
cards.exUz: Menda to'liq aql xatosi bo'ldi va uning ismini unutib qo'ydim.
cards.uzDef: Birdaniga biror narsani eslay olmay qolish holati.

cards.ex: I need to figure out how to fix my computer.
cards.exUz: Men kompyuterimni qanday tuzatishni tushunib yetishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish yoki biror narsani tushunish.

cards.ex: She picked up Spanish really quickly when she moved to Spain.
cards.exUz: U Ispaniyaga ko'chib o'tgandan keyin ispan tilini juda tez o'rganib oldi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ko'nikma yoki bilimni tezda o'rganish.

cards.ex: You'd think he'd have the common sense to wear a coat in this weather.
cards.exUz: U bunday ob-havoda palto kiyish uchun oddiy aqlga ega bo'lishi kerak deb o'ylaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Kundalik hayotda to'g'ri qarorlar qabul qilish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: He's book smart, but he doesn't know how to fix a leaky faucet.
cards.exUz: U kitobiy bilimdon, lekin oqayotgan kranni qanday tuzatishni bilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat kitoblardan o'rgangan, amaliy tajribasi yo'q bilim.

cards.ex: You need to be street smart to survive in this city.
cards.exUz: Bu shaharda omon qolish uchun hayotiy tajribaga ega bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hayotiy tajribaga ega, qiyin vaziyatlarda o'zini tuta oladigan.

cards.ex: He's a bit slow on the uptake, but he's a hard worker.
cards.exUz: U biroz sekin fahmlaydi, lekin u tirishqoq ishchi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani tushunish uchun ko'proq vaqt kerak bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: She's a bright spark; she always has great ideas.
cards.exUz: U zehnli odam; u har doim ajoyib g'oyalarga ega.
cards.uzDef: Aql-zakovatli, tez fahmlaydigan odam.

cards.ex: It was just dumb luck that I found my keys.
cards.exUz: Men kalitlarimni topganim faqat omadsizlik edi.
cards.uzDef: Aqlsizlik tufayli yuzaga kelgan omad.

cards.ex: My grandfather is a wise owl; he always gives good advice.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom donishmand; u har doim yaxshi maslahat beradi.
cards.uzDef: Katta tajribaga ega va maslahatlari qimmatli odam.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes in a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishlashni o'rganish uchun vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ishni yoki vaziyatni o'rganish, ko'nikish.

cards.ex: I have a hunch that she's not telling the truth.
cards.exUz: Mening sezgim bor, u haqiqatni aytmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida aniq dalillar bo'lmasa ham, his qilish.

cards.ex: I can't wrap my head around this new software.
cards.exUz: Men bu yangi dasturiy ta'minotni tushunishga harakat qila olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror murakkab narsani tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's a quick study and will be able to handle the job.
cards.exUz: U tez o'rganuvchi va ishni uddalay oladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsalarni tez va oson o'rganadigan odam.

cards.ex: If I can put my two cents in, I think we should try a different approach.
cards.exUz: Agar men o'z fikrimni bildirsam, biz boshqa yondashuvni sinab ko'rishimiz kerak deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini yoki maslahatini bildirish.

cards.ex: He seems a bit out to lunch today; he's not paying attention.
cards.exUz: U bugun biroz aqldan ozganga o'xshaydi; u e'tibor bermayapti.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatli bo'lmagan yoki aqlsizona harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: Accepting that job offer was a no-brainer.
cards.exUz: Ish taklifini qabul qilish oson qaror edi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylamasdan qabul qilinadigan oson qaror.

cards.ex: We're on the same wavelength, so we work well together.
cards.exUz: Biz bir xil fikrdamiz, shuning uchun birgalikda yaxshi ishlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, bir-birini yaxshi tushunish.

cards.ex: I think he's not playing with a full deck, if you know what I mean.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, uning aqli to'liq emas, agar siz nimani nazarda tutayotganimni bilsangiz.
cards.term: Not playing with a full deck
cards.uzDef: Aqli zaifroq yoki normal darajada fikrlay olmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: I need to hit the books if I want to pass the exam.
cards.exUz: Agar imtihondan o'tmoqchi bo'lsam, o'qishga jiddiy kirishishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'qishga jiddiy kirishish, ko'p o'qish.

cards.ex: You need to wise up and stop making bad decisions.
cards.exUz: Siz aqlingizni ishlatishingiz va yomon qarorlar qabul qilishni to'xtatishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ahmoqona harakat qilishni to'xtatib, aql bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's a bit of an airhead, but she's very kind.
cards.exUz: U biroz behahm, lekin u juda mehribon.
cards.uzDef: Aqli zaif, o'ylamasdan gapiradigan odam.

cards.ex: You need to have your wits about you when you're driving in this city.
cards.exUz: Bu shaharda mashina haydashda hushyor bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tez fikrlash va vaziyatga moslashish qobiliyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's starting to lose his marbles; he keeps forgetting things.
cards.exUz: U aqldan oza boshlayapti; u doimo narsalarni unutadi.
cards.uzDef: G'alati yoki aqlsizona harakat qila boshlash.

cards.ex: Don't be a copycat; try to be original.
cards.exUz: Taqlidchi bo'lma; original bo'lishga harakat qil.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning harakatlarini, g'oyalarini taqlid qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: You need street smarts to survive in that neighborhood.
cards.exUz: Ushbu mahallada omon qolish uchun hayotiy aql kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin hayotiy vaziyatlardan chiqib ketish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: He's so thick-headed; I can't believe he doesn't understand.
cards.exUz: U juda ahmoq; Men uning tushunmasligiga ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Tushunishi qiyin, o'ta ahmoq odam.

cards.ex: Just use your head and think before you act.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki aqlingni ishlat va harakat qilishdan oldin o'ylab ko'r.
cards.uzDef: Aql bilan, o'ylab harakat qilish.
